messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — ACME Analytics says their free-trial credits never showed up in their active workspace. Billing UI shows 0 on acme-prod but credits are visible somewhere else. Can someone triage?

Eli (Support): Got it. Customer email? workspace IDs? Any screenshots or billing invoice IDs?

Maya (CS): Customer email is billing@acme.com, owner James Li. They say credits were applied from promo 'ACME-TRIAL-2026' when they signed up via SSO. Suspect a cloned workspace. org_id: org_acme_7890, expected workspace: ws_prod_001 (acme-prod).

Noah (AcctOps): Running a quick lookup. Query: 
```sql
SELECT id, amount_credits, workspace_id, created_at, metadata->>'provision_source' as src
FROM credits
WHERE org_id = 'org_acme_7890'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Result: 2 credit rows (cr_1001, cr_1002) amount 15000 each attached to workspace_id 'ws_4521' (acme-sandbox-2). provision_source = 'scim_provision'.

Sara (Engineering): Sounds like SCIM/SAML provisioning created a duplicate workspace during an IdP reprovision. I've seen this when externalId changes. Can you paste the SCIM event log?

Maya (CS): Pasting the portion of the SCIM log we received from the customer: 
```
2026-02-12T15:02:03Z INFO SCIM_PROV event=create target=org_acme_7890 externalId=ACME-SO-2 created_workspace=ws_4521 initiated_by=user:jsmith@acme.com
2026-02-12T15:02:03Z INFO SAML map: NameID changed from 'acme/prod' to 'acme/prod#2' during idp reconfigure
```
They upgraded their IdP and re-ran provisioning around the same time the trial was granted.

infra-bot: Automated detection: Found 2 workspaces in org_acme_7890 with overlapping owner emails and different externalIds. Possible duplicate workspace created via SCIM at 2026-02-12T15:02:03Z. Recommend manual verify before reassigning credits.

Noah (AcctOps): Agree verify first. Customer confirmed they do not use acme-sandbox-2. They only want credits on acme-prod. I can prepare a safe reassign script. Proposed steps: 1) snapshot credits table 2) run update in a transaction, 3) write audit row. SQL: 
```sql
BEGIN;
INSERT INTO credits_audit (credit_id, old_workspace, new_workspace, changed_by, changed_at)
SELECT id, workspace_id, 'ws_prod_001', 'acctops/noah', now() FROM credits WHERE id IN ('cr_1001','cr_1002');
UPDATE credits SET workspace_id = 'ws_prod_001' WHERE id IN ('cr_1001','cr_1002');
COMMIT;
```
I will also add a ticket tag so CS can notify the customer once done.

Sara (Engineering): Quick note — make sure to invalidate any cached billing aggregates for org_acme_7890 and re-run the nightly reconcile job for accuracy. I'll add a small script to clear the cache key: `billing:org_acme_7890:agg_v1`.

Maya (CS): Thanks. @Noah please run during low-traffic window and paste the audit rows after. I'll confirm with James before final change.

Eli (Support): Also check for duplicate webhook/service accounts: the credits rows have metadata.provision_source=scim_provision — confirm this wasn't an automated promo trigger from a separate integration.

Maya (CS): I pinged James (customer) for explicit confirmation to move credits and asked for CFO note. He replied: "Please move asap, we only use acme-prod and need to show credits in invoices."

Noah (AcctOps): I'll schedule the change at 02:00 UTC (low traffic). Will paste audit rows and transaction id here after completion.

infra-bot: Change scheduled: acctops/noah will run credits reassign for org_acme_7890 at 2026-03-05T02:00:00Z. Incident reference: CHG-48291.

Maya (CS): Closing loop — after the change I'll confirm in the billing UI and notify customer. If SSO creates duplicates again we'll need to add a guard in provisioning.

Sara (Engineering): I'll add a validation on the SCIM handler to block create if an org already has a workspace with the same owner email and an active billing footprint. I'll open a PR and link it to CHG-48291.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — keeping this thread for the audit.
